title: The Background Equations of Kaku's Membrane Sigma Model Are Not Integrable
description: The two-loop background equations of Kaku's bosonic membrane sigma model (Phys. Rev. D 61, 085025, 2000) force F^2 to be constant on every solution, which excludes the membrane solution and the Freund-Rubin vacua; the one-loop system called inconsistent there is integrable; and the two-loop sunset integral has a pole at d = 3 in dimensional regularization.
